release.notes: 这是 v0.16.0 的补丁发版，修两个会影响启动和更新体积的问题。 ## 修复 - **独立入口在装有第三方 bundle 的 profile 上启动失败** — #1577 把后端装配放到了延迟根守卫之前。profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里有 `@deepseek-ai/*` 和 dsh-tui 之外的包时，装配会提前解析组合根，根能力守卫立刻装上且撤不掉；DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的基础行在 `ctx.root.accessor('invocation')` 处被拒，`plugin-manager`、`llm`、`commands` 等 9 个必需插件无法激活，`agent-loop` 等不到 `llm`。现在延迟紧跟在入口绑定根之后，排在装配和内核选择之前，恢复 0.15.0 的守卫时序。([#1598](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1598) by @MomentDerek；维护者修复 by @ccch1mneyyy) - **更新时不再把其他平台的 Claude SDK 包拉进 profile** — pnpm 更新会物化所有平台的 optional dependency；0.15 → 0.16 曾把七个 `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-*` 包（约 1.6GB）装进 profile store，而实际只会链接当前平台的那一个。现在更新和按需安装内核都会按本机 platform/arch/libc 过滤；Claude SDK 仍是按需安装的可选后端，普通更新不会自动加。([#1600](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1600) by @ccch1mneyyy) ## 兼容与升级 - 从 v0.16.0 升级：程序内 `/update`，或 `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui@0.16.1`。 - 已在 0.16.0 遇到启动失败：升级到 0.16.1 即可，不必再钉回 0.15.0、移除第三方 bundle 或先升 DSH。 - 一键安装包 `dsh-tui-setup.zip`、各平台 `dsh-tui-standalone-*` 便携包与 `SHA256SUMS` 仍在 Release 资产里。 ## 安装 ```sh npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui@0.16.1 ``` 偏好一键安装的用户可下载 Release 中的 `dsh-tui-setup.zip`，解压后按平台运行 `install.sh` 或 `install.ps1`；便携包解压即用。 ## What's Changed * fix(update): install only this platform's Claude SDK bundle by @ccch1mneyyy in https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1600 * fix(host): defer the root guard before the entry's backend assembly by @MomentDerek in https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/pull/1598 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/compare/v0.16.0...v0.16.1

release.notes: # October 16th, 2026 Release ### New Features - Claude Code sessions suggest your next prompt in the empty input after a turn; press Tab to fill it in (toggle in Agent Features). - Claude Agent sessions stopped by a usage limit can continue on their own once the limit resets; turn it on from the limit card in the transcript or in Agent Features. - **New editor blocks:** charts, callouts, columns, tabs, a table of contents, transclusions, `@` mentions of people and dates, link previews, video players, code excerpts, and buttons that start an agent session or create a new item. Most can be resized and edited from the block menu. - **Interactive HTML pages:** a link to an `.html` file on its own line embeds it live in a document, sandboxed from the app, and its links open pages, tracker items and files in Nimbalyst. - **CSV spreadsheet editor:** a formatting toolbar, conditional formatting, data validation, wrap text, freezing, a status bar, formula autocomplete with click-to-insert references, named ranges, spreadsheet keyboard shortcuts, paste from other spreadsheet apps, and undo for every edit. Agents can edit sheets with A1-range tools, including files that aren't open. - Reorder projects in the rail by dragging or from the context menu, or sort them by name (#1126, contributed by @jszobody). - Customize a project's initials, color, or image in Project Settings > Appearance (#784, contributed by @jszobody). - After enlarging an image in a session transcript, the Left and Right arrow keys step through the session's other images. ### Improvements - A document's frontmatter properties and cited sources now sit in a resizable Page info panel opened from the header. - Pages search and the tracker toolbar show active filters, tags and source as pills inside the search box; Import moved into the New menu. - The meta agent's delegated sessions panel can be folded away, giving the transcript the full width on a narrow window (contributed by @karlwirth). - Sessions that hand off to a new session can go past eight handoffs, and agents can place a spawned session beside themselves instead of nested under them. - Following external Claude Code and Codex sessions watches each session folder instead of keeping every transcript file open, which had reached over 2,000 open files on one machine. - Extension docs and SDK comments now describe the file patterns that custom editors and document headers actually match (#1666, contributed by @theluckystrike). - Updated Claude Agent SDK to 0.3.300 and Codex SDK to 0.162.1. ### Fixed - In a project spanning several repositories, the title-bar branch, the Git operations panel and the new-worktree dialog follow the file open in the editor instead of always using the first repository, and pulling or pushing one repository from the title bar shows its progress without greying out the others (contributed by @Knifiel). - Quick Open, @ mentions and content search find files in git repositories cloned inside a project (#1449, contributed by @Knifiel). - Files @-mentioned to chat providers without file tools are read from attached folders too, and no longer from a sibling folder whose name starts with the project's (contributed by @Knifiel). - An agent session in a worktree can read and edit folders attached to either the worktree or its project (contributed by @Knifiel). - Archiving a worktree that was interrupted by quitting the app finishes cleanly on the next launch, and archiving a worktree with unmerged commits no longer skips its warning because a similarly named branch was already merged (contributed by @Knifiel). - Expanded deep folders in the file tree stay visible and current when files change elsewhere (contributed by @Knifiel). - Cmd+Alt+W (Ctrl+Alt+W on Windows and Linux) opens the new-worktree dialog instead of creating a worktree with a generated name (contributed by @Knifiel). - Archiving a session shows an error when it fails, and no longer hangs when a worktree's git remote stops responding (#282, contributed by @CaptainMittens). - The "Show recent commits" widget no longer comes up empty when the agent passes a folder path (#382, contributed by @CaptainMittens). - An error from an earlier turn, such as the "You are logged in" login card, no longer stays pinned to the bottom of a session after later turns (#1663, contributed by @tsvtdy). - Copilot tool calls show their tool name, arguments and result instead of "unknown", and Copilot messages are labeled "Copilot Agent" (#1658, contributed by @codeapplied). - Shell commands no longer appear as sub-agents in the agent sidebar, and a stopped task no longer looks the same as one that failed (contributed by @Sergio-3). - A question left open when the agent connection drops no longer leaves the session waiting for your response (#1557, contributed by @stephane-camhaji-sx). - Commit with AI from the Git panel no longer fails with "Session not found" when the selected repository is nested inside the project folder (contributed by @hmmmzaDev). - Asking an agent to turn on a feature this build does not have now reports that, instead of saying it worked (#1501, contributed by @L4XB). - Codex sessions no longer fail to start when an HTTP MCP server is also listed in `~/.codex/config.toml` (#1503, contributed by @moriosoft). - Sending queued messages to Codex no longer fails with an overlapping-turn error when interrupting a session. - A message queued during a Claude Code agent turn no longer cancels a question the agent asks; it waits until you answer. - Nimbalyst's background branch and file status checks no longer lock the git index, which could make a `git pull --rebase` with autostash leave your uncommitted changes in the stash. - Windows updates no longer fail with "Get-AuthenticodeSignature" when checking the downloaded installer's signature takes longer than 20 seconds. - macOS: Cmd+` cycles windows again while an agent drives a headless browser session. - Clicking or dropping a file in the empty space
